query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Analyze WhatsApp-style broadcast campaigns in Kommo CRM, including detected campaign sends, audience reach, replies, conversions, templates, segments, and related agent activity.

query_ground_truth.intent: Retrieve detected WhatsApp broadcast campaign sends, templates, and audience reach metrics in Kommo CRM.

results.execution_guidance: Found 3 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Botbaba provides APIs for building and managing chatbots, including conversational AI and messaging integrations.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=botbaba. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="botbaba") to create a connection BEFORE executing any botbaba tools.

BOTBABA_LIST_BROADCASTS.description: Tool to list all broadcast campaigns. Use when retrieving BotBaba broadcast campaigns with pagination.

limit.description: Number of broadcasts to retrieve per request (1-100)

BOTBABA_GET_BROADCAST.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific broadcast. Use when you need to confirm broadcast settings or status after creating or scheduling a broadcast.

broadcast_id.description: Unique identifier of the broadcast to retrieve

BOTBABA_DELETE_BROADCAST.description: Tool to delete a broadcast campaign. Use when you need to permanently remove a Botbaba broadcast by its ID after confirming it exists.

broadcast_id.description: Unique identifier of the broadcast campaign to delete
